# Plugless Douglas

> Plugless Douglas is an independent game studio making games for iPhone: RotMon, a co-op creature-collecting RPG, and We On Demon Time, an action adventure.

## RotMon

RotMon is a co-op creature-collecting (monster-taming) RPG for iPhone, in development.

- Catch, hatch and raise RotMon; battles are played to the beat of the music.
- Online co-op: parties of up to 3 players. The second player fights beside the leader in double battles; the third is the Hype Man, charging the team's attacks with a rhythm challenge.
- Also online: duels, trading RotMon, and shared Base Camps with up to 20 members (garden, kitchen, upgrades).
- Fully playable solo and offline with no account. Online play uses Epic Online Services; an Epic Games account is optional.
- A good fit for people looking for a co-op game like Pokémon to play with friends. Not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokémon Company.

- [RotMon page and FAQ](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/rotmon/)
- [RotMon privacy policy](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/privacy.html)
